chart_rules: Separate measured samples from maker specs visibly.
Never invent runtime from capacity without measured average current and matching firmware/polling.
No universal low-density or fastest claim from selected sample.
Pareto fronts have legitimate corners; use points/steps or labelled visual guide, not a smoothed curve pretending to be measured.

teaching.demo: Two views of the SAME ruler: broad face bends, edge resists; rotate in 2D with end-on inset.
teaching.principle: Section geometry changes flexural rigidity without adding material.
teaching.boundary: 100x is illustrative ideal rectangular beam calculation, not measured Theseus shell performance. Deflection is not failure strength.

teaching.demo: Press a four-straw square; joints rotate into a parallelogram. Add one diagonal and repeat. Put a simple triangle beside it.
teaching.principle: Triangulation removes an in-plane pin-jointed mechanism.
teaching.boundary: Do not say triangles are always strongest or cannot bend. Real ribs bend/buckle; topology, joint rigidity, wall thickness and load determine performance.

teaching.demo: Hang short chain between supports, freeze shape, flip upright; show supports resisting outward spread, then add PCB tie.
teaching.principle: Tension form-finding inverted produces a compression-funicular structure for corresponding loads.
teaching.boundary: Mouse shell with arbitrary hand loads is not automatically pure compression. Show tie/support condition; moving/removing supports destroys comparison.

teaching.demo: Wood bundle in two orientations; pulling parallel to long fibers loads them; splitting lengthwise separates between fibers. Transition to directional rib flow.
teaching.principle: Anisotropy: mechanical response depends on loading direction.
teaching.boundary: Splitting along grain is easy while tensile strength along fibers is high; avoid confusing crack direction with load direction. Short molded fibers are not continuous unidirectional carbon laminate.

teaching.demo: Stack schematic mouse shell, guide, switch, board; each has a small +/- error. A fixed clearance line shows total dimensional error consume a gap.
teaching.principle: Worst-case absolute tolerance sum; independent random dimensional variances add for a linear stack.
teaching.boundary: RSS needs independent centered processes with the same statistical coverage. Never claim fewer parts alone proves yield; warpage, mold variation and correlated errors matter.

teaching.demo: An input path crosses several essential parts; one broken link blocks the whole action. Remove unnecessary link.
teaching.boundary: Use as conditional model, not a measured mouse reliability statistic. Series model is not a substitute for dimensional tolerance analysis.

hall_example.label: DS
hall_example.part: TMAG5253, example only; not selected Theseus encoder
hall_example.boundary: These are one sensor's currents, excluding MCU, ADC, regulator and any second Hall channel. Slow sampling can miss fast wheel changes. Hall has no LED; not zero power. Dust does not obstruct an optical path, but physical wheel/detent bearings still wear.

hall3d_example.label: DS
hall3d_example.boundary: Power mode and configured wake interval determine actual consumption; not Theseus selected component.

optical_scenario.label: DV-not-measurement
optical_scenario.local_source: deck/src/10-b-click.js: optical battery share worked model
optical_scenario.boundary: Omron datasheet electrical test pulses are NOT proof of Razer's real LED schedule, switch current or efficiency. Battery-cell and switch-rail currents are not directly comparable without voltages and conversion losses. NOT verified Viper energy share. Mechanical sensing still requires pullups/scanning.

razer_almost_half.label: CA via Brock
razer_almost_half.approved_wording: Brock reports Razer staff online said switches plus encoder use almost half; no public quotation found.
razer_almost_half.boundary: Do not turn into 2x Theseus measured/guaranteed runtime. If display retained, attribution and unknown measurement conditions must be visible.

runtime_rule.boundary: Capacity mAh cannot fill missing runtime. State polling, mode, battery size, usage and firmware; otherwise show not published. Current average is valid only at same rail with conversion accounted.

matched_small_batteries.boundary: These are concrete examples, not a universal chemistry advantage or selected Theseus battery. Compare finished protected packs before procurement.

conformal.label: DS
conformal.boundary: Moisture/environmental protection manufacturer claim; not waterproof certification. Liquid density0.91g/cm3 is not cured-film density; final coated-board mass must be weighed.

direct_drive.label: DV geometry; PR Theseus mechanism
direct_drive.headline: 94% â†’ 100% force along the switch axis
direct_drive.approved_phrase: 6% sooner (F31.2), only as visibly labelled ideal kinematic model if preserved
direct_drive.boundary: Vector geometry is not measured press-to-PC latency, reaction time or a universal time prediction. A constant-speed kinematic projection and a force-driven acceleration model do not predict the same timing. Say removes misalignment/side loading without quantified speed claim unless model assumptions are shown.

target_boundary.Theseus: 29/29.31g, runtime, density, strength, press-to-PC and price remain proposal/model targets until actual prototype test. Integrator chooses one authoritative computed mass; no rounding target into achieved fact.
